canonical.behaviour: Phase 1 of checking things in the real app, as agreed in agreement 3. workflow-axa gets two new skills written as its own text from pstack (MIT, credited in VENDORED-SKILLS.md, not installed): verify-app, which writes and maintains an app's verify skill and feature map, with a guide for adding screens and new jobs and a browser-guard template; and reproduce-bug, the bug job, which reproduces a bug report twice in the running app and checks a known fix, with the outcomes Reproduced, Could not reproduce, Blocked, Fix confirmed and Fix not confirmed. Both are registered and tested in the package. Then, in the the test app labeler, verify-app writes .claude/skills/verify-labeler/ with a map of My labels; it must pass the 9-step setup check and the guard checks, where production is refused and other hosts are blocked. The first test checks the filter-dot fix 502db1f, the eval checks two more fixed bugs, and a second screen is added by following only the guide. One assumption changed: the candidate skills are read by path from D:\workflow-axa in the labeler session, instead of through tools/stage_candidate.py, which only builds a separate sandbox repository (E6).
operations: git worktree add and git worktree remove in D:\<test app> for 502db1f^, 502db1f and the two eval commits, inside .artifacts/2026-11-18-bug-reproducer/; one directory link to the main checkout's node_modules per worktree, removed as a link
start the labeler dev server on port 8101 and run Playwright against the owner's local backend only
write in D:\<test app>: .claude/skills/verify-labeler/ (verify skill, features/, eval.md, guard settings) and captures in .artifacts/2026-11-18-bug-reproducer/
exclusions: No change to the backend repository <test backend>.
No change to the labeler's app code, environment files, existing e2e tests, tests/e2e/utils.ts or AGENTS.md; no CSS.
No git commit, push or branch in either repository unless the owner asks.
No run against <production host 1>, <local backend name>, <production host 3> or any host other than the owner's local backend.
No version bump, release, plugin install or cache replacement; no change to the installed plugin.
Nothing in Paperclip, Trello, Hermes or workflow-paperclip; nothing after phase 1.
The workflow's bug recipe does not call reproduce-bug.
conditions: If 502db1f^ does not run against today's local backend, T5 is Blocked and the next candidate bug is used, recorded in FINDINGS.
No login, token or client data in a skill, record or capture.

T4 to T7 start only after the owner gives P1 to P4: the local backend's address, what its database holds, a test account with labels in the labeler's .env.e2e.local, and CORS for the dev server. If the database is a copy of production, a fictional test company comes first.
The owner picks the second screen for T7.
checks: independent review of each ticket and of the whole feature
labeler afterwards: git worktree list shows only the main checkout, node_modules intact, git status shows only the verify skill files plus the owner's earlier changes
labeler: eval of three fixed bugs each right on both commits
labeler: first test 502db1f gives Fix confirmed with videos, screenshots and the dot position; owner watches the videos
labeler: second screen added by following GUIDE.md, its setup check passes; owner says the guide is clear
labeler: the 9-step setup check and the two guard runs, results in FINDINGS
python -X utf8 -I tools/validate.py and python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py": no new failing names compared with the baseline taken before T1
python -X utf8 -m unittest tests.test_verify_skills -v (new): required sections, outcome words, guard template, no job words in layer 1, no source or company names
